data.narrative:
Adarga is a Series B defense and security company that has raised $26.2M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies across Defense & Security—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private entities—including five same-stage peers: Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression uses total capital raised ($26.2M) as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $50M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks Adarga against the six same-sector, same-stage comparables, which display a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range of $300M to $3.0B.

The triangulated analysis yields a valuation range of $42M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $587M. The wide spread reflects material tension between early-stage capital deployment ($50M implied) and peer-set valuations, where the median exceeds Adarga's fundraising by 42x. Key uncertainties driving the range include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers, customer concentration in government contracts, and competitive positioning within the frontier-tech defense ecosystem. Resolution of these factors would anchor the valuation toward either the stage-progression floor or the peer-median anchor.
